TypePayment.description:
Payment method.

* `Free` — subscription is free; no payment requested
* `ExternalCheck` — payment by check
* `ExternalCash` — payment by cash
* `ExternalBank` — payment by wire transfer
* `ExternalOther` — other external payment method
* `Card` — card payment with automated renewal
* `DirectDebit` — bank account debit with automated renewal
